digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 plan review executor (chunk and agent pool)
propositions: With a cold cache, the 6-wide Pass-1 pool redundantly writes the shared plan prefix across multiple concurrent calls, incurring 3.7x more effective plan tokens than necessary.

The warm-then-fan-out pattern (already proven for container bins) should be ported to the main Pass-1 pool: run the first chunk serially to write the cache prefix, then fan out the remainder to the pool.
The warm gate activates when estimated shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and there are >= 2 Pass-1 calls; non-systemic warm failures degrade gracefully to direct fan-out.
A single warm call produces one cache write; the N-1 fanned-out calls should each hit cache reads, reducing redundant writes to zero.
